title: Viva Glint: Copilot admin configuration assistant for how-to guidance
summary: The roadmap facts, guidance-only behavior and documented Copilot access controls are supported. The licensing notes should name the existing product subscription, and the admin path should continue to the On or Off choice. The statement that administrators are often HR or people-analytics staff rather than IT is not supported by the sources checked.

claims.where: What's changing; title; summary
claims.claim: The Viva Glint admin configuration assistant is built on Microsoft Copilot and embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience.
claims.quote: The Viva Glint admin configuration assistant is an AI-powered experience, built on Microsoft Copilot, that is embedded directly in the Viva Glint admin experience.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Administrators can ask configuration and how-to questions in plain language and receive conversational, step-by-step guidance.
claims.quote: Ask in plain language—for example, "How do I add missing survey takers?"—and the assistant will guide you to the right steps and settings.

claims.where: What's changing; summary

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The assistant uses the existing product entitlement, represented by licensing.model included.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The org-wide Copilot in Viva Glint control is reached through Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Manage settings for Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint > Org-wide setting > Manage in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: In the Manage Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint pane, select Manage in the Org-wide setting section. ... Choose On.
claims.fix: Extend the front-matter and rendered-table path to 'Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Manage settings for Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint > Org-wide setting > Manage > On / Off', matching the cited page's enable and disable procedures.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaGlint -FeatureId <featureId> -Name <policyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the selected feature.
claims.quote: Glint | VivaGlint ... Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false ... If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose

claims.fix: Retain the roles from the feature-specific access page. Add: 'The general VFAM feature table lists only Global admin for Glint, while the feature-specific access page also lists Viva Glint Tenant Administrators and AI Administrators.' The differing table is at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/feature-access-management.
